description: This file handles PayPal webhook events, including verifying webhook signatures, processing payment success, and managing related data interactions with Prisma ORM. It defines API route handlers, schema validations, and utility functions specific to PayPal webhook processing.

classes.name: Paypal
classes.description: A class representing the PayPal client used for obtaining access tokens and verifying webhooks.

methods.name: handlePaypalPaymentSuccess
methods.description: Processes a successful PayPal payment webhook, verifies the webhook, and triggers payment success handling.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: API route handler for processing incoming webhook requests, validating headers and payload, and delegating to payment success handler.

methods.name: findPaymentCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves PayPal credentials and webhook ID associated with a booking, with error handling.
